newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore school bans brand watches on campus.
newsitem.headline: Singapore school bans brand watches on campus.

text.p: A Singapore school has banned brand name watches on campus to teach students not to be vain, the Chinese-language Lianhe Zaobao newspaper reported on Saturday.
The Cedar Girls Secondary School has asked its students not to wear some locally popular brands and watches worth over S$40 (US$28) to school, the report said.
As a result, the newspaper said, students have started wearing counterfeit brand watches which cost less than S$40.
